# Test fixtures

CURRENT FACT: persistence tests own only local `shelfcash_test`. Alembic head is
`0017_planning_exports`; each test asserts its own invariant and resets only the
validated test target. Fixtures are synthetic, not customer data.

- `forecast_synthetic_input.json`: prepared synthetic capture generated by
  `scripts.forecast_demo`; 120 days from 2026-01-01 through 2026-04-30, two
  Products in cup units, 240 observed rows, no missing or zero rows.
  Quantity = 10 + 5 × (day_index % 7) + floor(day_index / 14) + 10 × product_code.
  Regenerate trusted local models with `scripts.forecast_model train`.
  Synthetic fit/metrics are not evidence of real forecast quality.
- `openapi_20261010.json`: exact original compatibility baseline, never current
  generated OpenAPI. [Provenance and hashes](../../docs/CONTRACT_COMPATIBILITY_CHANGELOG_VI.md).
- Procurement/planning fixtures and independent small-domain oracles specify
  exact quantities, costs, supplier fees, stock/FEFO, insufficient-budget and
  retained-state cases. Their expected facts belong beside the relevant tests.
- PDF fonts/licenses under product resources are required source assets;
  generated PDF exports belong in private ignored runtime.

Historical schema-only fixtures do not prove later application/HTTP behavior.
`decision_assistant/*.json` are interned static synthetic stock/purchase/infeasible
pipeline + resolved setup graphs from existing runtime/s363_review/results inputs.
Each file records original input SHA-256; `$node` references deduplicate identical
JSON objects and are expanded by tests/assistant_cases.py, never application code.
No solver was invoked to create these fixtures. Hand-assembled PlanningRun/public
audit wrappers are explicitly synthetic read-contract fixtures, not user runs or
new accuracy/Planning evidence. They preserve old /2 semantics and original numbers;
the legacy ZIP is not a runtime dependency.
Integration seed tools create deterministic examples through approved commands;
they never imply a production seed or permission to reseed an existing DB.

The `decision_assistant/conversational_realistic.json` fixture is a static interned
PlanningRun: two captured milk labels, fixed1/1 versus2/2 pack baskets,5/10VND and
50/100 percent service. A one-time exact evaluator authored fixed baskets without
search/solver/forecast; consumption only decodes/consistency-checks the graph.
`l31_wording_corpus.json` has hand-authored expected facts/main-answer labels;
saved-live wording forms are development regression, not unseen evidence. Probe
false rejections are reported without changing their valid labels.
